card.name: Second half of label section headings
card.fires_on: The closing word of a heading or term in drug labels, such as the "ication" of "Indication" in dosing tables, "use" in "Pediatric use", and "Populations" in "Use in Specific Populations".

modes.label: Indication table header
modes.description: The "ication" ending of "Indication" as the first column heading of a dosing table.
modes.example: Quetiapine tablets can be taken with or without food ( 2.1 ) Ind<<ication>> Initial Dose Recommended Dose Maximum D

modes.label: Pediatric use heading
modes.description: The word "use" or "USE" after "Pediatric" in cross-references or notes.
modes.example: Pediatric<< use>> information is approved for Viatris Specialty

modes.label: Other label terms
modes.description: The last word of a medical or section term such as "differentiation syndrome" or "Specific Populations".

card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a standard label heading, like Indication or Pediatric use, just before the heading is complete.
